shortcutBookkeeping.title: iPhone Shortcut Bookkeeping
shortcutBookkeeping.entryDescription: Back Tap, OCR a screenshot, then confirm before saving
shortcutBookkeeping.introDescription: Your iPhone extracts text locally. In Whale Wave, you choose a ledger, verify the amount and category, and only then save the record.
shortcutBookkeeping.credentialDescription: A credential can only submit text for review. It cannot read ledgers or create records. Use a separate one per device.
shortcutBookkeeping.newCredentialHint: For security, the full credential is only shown once.
shortcutBookkeeping.revokeDescription: Installed shortcuts will immediately stop creating new drafts.
shortcutBookkeeping.saveFailed: Unable to complete the action. Try again later.
shortcutBookkeeping.step1: Add Take Screenshot, then Calculate Hash (SHA-256) and Extract Text from Image.
shortcutBookkeeping.step2: Add Get Contents of URL, choose POST, and use a JSON request body.
shortcutBookkeeping.step3: Use the request URL below. Set Authorization to Bearer, a space, then the credential above.
shortcutBookkeeping.step4: Send rawText, the screenshot SHA-256 hash as clientRequestId, and the current date as capturedAt.
shortcutBookkeeping.step5: Get data.confirmationUrl from the response, then open it with Open URLs.
shortcutBookkeeping.backTapDescription: Settings → Accessibility → Touch → Back Tap → Double Tap, then select your shortcut.
shortcutBookkeeping.browserLoginHint: Open URLs normally uses Safari and cannot reliably enter an installed Home Screen PWA. Safari and the PWA may have separate sign-in state, so sign in when prompted on first use.
shortcutBookkeeping.draftDescription: Nothing is saved automatically. Choose a ledger and verify the extracted details first.
shortcutBookkeeping.loadFailed: The draft is missing, expired, or belongs to another account
shortcutBookkeeping.noWritableLedger: This account has no ledger that accepts new records
shortcutBookkeeping.discardDescription: The OCR text and detected candidates will be cleared immediately, and the confirmation link will stop working.
shortcutBookkeeping.saveRecordFailed: Unable to save the record. Try again later.
